Two players, five balls each. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the other player does.
You always strike one of your own balls: your marked ball while it is on the table, then your others one at a time, lowest number first.
Sink one of your own balls in your cup and you shoot again. Otherwise the turn passes.
A ball in the wrong cup, or any ball knocked off the table, is a foul. That ball goes back to where it started and the turn passes.
The first side with all five balls in its cup wins, whoever sank the last one. An opponent's ball you knock into their own cup counts for them.
Two players: one plays the white, the other the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
Strike your own ball so it hits the other player's ball first. Points come from what that ball and the red do next.
Each white pin down scores %lld. The red pin scores %lld, or %lld if it is the only pin to fall. The other player's ball hitting the red scores %lld.
Missing the other ball, hitting the red first, knocking a pin with your own ball, or sending a ball off the table is a foul. The shot's points go to the other player, and never fewer than %lld.
Turns alternate after every shot. The pins are stood up again, and a ball resting on a pin's spot goes back to its own spot.
The first to %lld points wins.
One or two players against a %lld-minute clock. Two players take breaks in turn and the higher score wins; alone, you play for your best score.
Every shot is a white from the tray, placed on the spot in the D. The red starts on its own spot.
Your ball must hit another ball first. Each ball that then drops scores the number by its hole, and the red scores double.
Your break goes on while every shot drops a ball. A shot that drops nothing ends it; a shot that hits no ball scores nothing and ends it.
Knock down a white peg and the break ends with its points lost. Knock down the black peg and your whole score is lost.
Dropped balls come back to the tray and the red goes back on its spot, until time is up.
When the clock runs out a bar drops: balls that drop stay down. Play goes on until no white is left, then the game ends. The clock stops while you watch a replay or the Lens.

translations.text: Une bille dans le mauvais trou, ou toute bille sortie de la table, est une faute. Elle retourne à son point de départ et la main passe.

translations.key: A ball in the wrong cup, or any ball knocked off the table, is a foul. That ball goes back to where it started and the turn passes.
translations.text: Eine Kugel im falschen Loch oder eine Kugel vom Tisch ist ein Foul. Diese Kugel kommt an ihren Startplatz zurück und der andere ist am Zug.

translations.key: A ball in the wrong cup, or any ball knocked off the table, is a foul. That ball goes back to where it started and the turn passes.
translations.text: Una bilia nella buca sbagliata, o una bilia fuori dal tavolo, è fallo. Quella bilia torna dove era partita e il turno passa.

translations.key: A ball in the wrong cup, or any ball knocked off the table, is a foul. That ball goes back to where it started and the turn passes.
translations.text: Uma bola no buraco errado, ou qualquer bola atirada para fora da mesa, é falta. Essa bola volta para onde começou e passa a vez.

translations.key: A ball in the wrong cup, or any ball knocked off the table, is a foul. That ball goes back to where it started and the turn passes.
translations.text: Uma bola no buraco errado, ou qualquer bola jogada para fora da mesa, é falta. Essa bola volta para onde começou e passa a vez.

translations.key: A ball in the wrong cup, or any ball knocked off the table, is a foul. That ball goes back to where it started and the turn passes.
translations.text: 違う穴に入った球や、台から飛び出した球はファウルです。その球はスタート位置に戻り、交代になります。

translations.key: A ball in the wrong cup, or any ball knocked off the table, is a foul. That ball goes back to where it started and the turn passes.
translations.text: 다른 구멍에 들어간 공이나 테이블 밖으로 나간 공은 파울입니다. 그 공은 처음 자리로 돌아가고 차례가 넘어갑니다.

translations.key: A ball in the wrong cup, or any ball knocked off the table, is a foul. That ball goes back to where it started and the turn passes.
translations.text: 球进错洞或任何球飞出台面都是犯规。该球放回起始位置，换人。

translations.key: A ball in the wrong cup, or any ball knocked off the table, is a foul. That ball goes back to where it started and the turn passes.
translations.text: Шар в чужой лузе или любой шар, вылетевший со стола, — фол. Этот шар возвращается на начальное место, ход переходит.

translations.key: A ball in the wrong cup, or any ball knocked off the table, is a foul. That ball goes back to where it started and the turn passes.
translations.text: كرة في الحفرة الخطأ، أو أي كرة تخرج من الطاولة، خطأ. تعود تلك الكرة إلى مكان بدايتها وينتقل الدور.

translations.key: The first side with all five balls in its cup wins, whoever sank the last one. An opponent's ball you knock into their own cup counts for them.
translations.text: Gana el primer lado con sus cinco bolas en su copa, la haya metido quien la haya metido. Una bola del rival que metas en su copa cuenta para él.

translations.key: The first side with all five balls in its cup wins, whoever sank the last one. An opponent's ball you knock into their own cup counts for them.
translations.text: Le premier camp dont les cinq billes sont dans son trou gagne, quel que soit celui qui a rentré la dernière. Une bille adverse que vous rentrez dans son trou compte pour l’adversaire.

translations.key: The first side with all five balls in its cup wins, whoever sank the last one. An opponent's ball you knock into their own cup counts for them.
translations.text: Die Seite, die zuerst alle fünf Kugeln im Loch hat, gewinnt, egal wer die letzte versenkt hat. Eine gegnerische Kugel, die du in ihr Loch stößt, zählt für den Gegner.

translations.key: The first side with all five balls in its cup wins, whoever sank the last one. An opponent's ball you knock into their own cup counts for them.
translations.text: Vince il primo lato con tutte e cinque le bilie nella sua buca, chiunque abbia imbucato l’ultima. Una bilia avversaria che mandi nella sua buca conta per l’avversario.

translations.key: The first side with all five balls in its cup wins, whoever sank the last one. An opponent's ball you knock into their own cup counts for them.
translations.text: Ganha o primeiro lado com as cinco bolas no seu buraco, seja quem for que meteu a última. Uma bola do adversário que metas no buraco dele conta para ele.

translations.key: The first side with all five balls in its cup wins, whoever sank the last one. An opponent's ball you knock into their own cup counts for them.
translations.text: Ganha o primeiro lado com as cinco bolas no seu buraco, não importa quem encaçapou a última. Uma bola do adversário que você encaçapar no buraco dele conta para ele.

translations.key: The first side with all five balls in its cup wins, whoever sank the last one. An opponent's ball you knock into their own cup counts for them.
translations.text: 自分の5個がすべて自分の穴に入った側の勝ちです。最後の1個を誰が沈めたかは問いません。相手の球を相手の穴に入れた場合は相手の得点になります。

translations.key: The first side with all five balls in its cup wins, whoever sank the last one. An opponent's ball you knock into their own cup counts for them.
translations.text: 공 5개가 모두 자기 구멍에 먼저 들어간 쪽이 이깁니다. 마지막 공을 누가 넣었는지는 상관없습니다. 상대 공을 상대 구멍에 넣으면 상대 점수가 됩니다.

translations.key: The first side with all five balls in its cup wins, whoever sank the last one. An opponent's ball you knock into their own cup counts for them.
translations.text: 先让五个球全部进自己洞的一方获胜，无论最后一球是谁打进的。你把对方的球打进对方的洞，算对方的。

translations.key: The first side with all five balls in its cup wins, whoever sank the last one. An opponent's ball you knock into their own cup counts for them.
translations.text: Побеждает сторона, первой загнавшая все пять шаров в свою лузу, кто бы ни забил последний. Шар соперника, загнанный вами в его лузу, засчитывается ему.

translations.key: The first side with all five balls in its cup wins, whoever sank the last one. An opponent's ball you knock into their own cup counts for them.
translations.text: يفوز أول جانب تدخل كراته الخمس في حفرته، أيًّا كان من أدخل الأخيرة. كرة الخصم التي تدخلها في حفرته تُحسب له.

translations.key: Two players: one plays the white, the other the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: Dos jugadores: uno juega con la blanca y el otro con la amarilla. La bola roja y los cinco bolos del centro son de los dos.

translations.key: Two players: one plays the white, the other the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: Deux joueurs : l’un joue la blanche, l’autre la jaune. La bille rouge et les cinq quilles du centre sont communes.

translations.key: Two players: one plays the white, the other the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: Zwei Spieler: einer spielt die Weiße, der andere die Gelbe. Die rote Kugel und die fünf Kegel in der Mitte gehören beiden.

translations.key: Two players: one plays the white, the other the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: Due giocatori: uno gioca la bianca, l’altro la gialla. La bilia rossa e i cinque birilli al centro sono di entrambi.

translations.key: Two players: one plays the white, the other the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: Dois jogadores: um joga com a branca, o outro com a amarela. A bola vermelha e os cinco pinos do meio são partilhados.

translations.key: Two players: one plays the white, the other the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: Dois jogadores: um joga com a branca, o outro com a amarela. A bola vermelha e os cinco pinos do meio são compartilhados.

translations.key: Two players: one plays the white, the other the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: 2人で、1人は白球、もう1人は黄球を使います。赤球と中央の5本のピンは共通です。

translations.key: Two players: one plays the white, the other the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: 두 사람이 한 명은 흰 공, 다른 한 명은 노란 공으로 칩니다. 빨간 공과 가운데 핀 5개는 함께 씁니다.

translations.key: Two players: one plays the white, the other the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: 两名玩家：一人用白球，另一人用黄球。红球和中间的五根木柱两人共用。

translations.key: Two players: one plays the white, the other the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: Два игрока: один играет белым, другой жёлтым. Красный шар и пять кеглей в центре общие.

translations.key: Two players: one plays the white, the other the yellow. The red ball and the five pins in the middle are shared.
translations.text: لاعبان: أحدهما يلعب بالبيضاء والآخر بالصفراء. الكرة الحمراء والأوتاد الخمسة في الوسط مشتركة.

translations.key: Strike your own ball so it hits the other player's ball first. Points come from what that ball and the red do next.
translations.text: Golpea tu bola para que toque primero la del otro jugador. Los puntos salen de lo que hagan después esa bola y la roja.

translations.key: Strike your own ball so it hits the other player's ball first. Points come from what that ball and the red do next.
translations.text: Jouez votre bille pour qu’elle touche d’abord celle de l’autre joueur. Les points viennent de ce que font ensuite cette bille et la rouge.

translations.key: Strike your own ball so it hits the other player's ball first. Points come from what that ball and the red do next.
translations.text: Spiel deine Kugel so, dass sie zuerst die Kugel des anderen trifft. Die Punkte kommen von dem, was diese Kugel und die Rote danach tun.

translations.key: Strike your own ball so it hits the other player's ball first. Points come from what that ball and the red do next.
translations.text: Colpisci la tua bilia in modo che prenda prima quella dell’altro giocatore. I punti vengono da ciò che fanno poi quella bilia e la rossa.

translations.key: Strike your own ball so it hits the other player's ball first. Points come from what that ball and the red do next.
translations.text: Joga a tua bola para que acerte primeiro na do outro jogador. Os pontos vêm do que essa bola e a vermelha fizerem a seguir.

translations.key: Strike your own ball so it hits the other player's ball first. Points come from what that ball and the red do next.
translations.text: Jogue sua bola para que acerte primeiro a do outro jogador. Os pontos vêm do que essa bola e a vermelha fizerem em seguida.

translations.key: Strike your own ball so it hits the other player's ball first. Points come from what that ball and the red do next.
translations.text: 自分の球を突いて、先に相手の球に当てます。得点は、そのあと相手の球と赤球が何をしたかで決まります。

translations.key: Strike your own ball so it hits the other player's ball first. Points come from what that ball and the red do next.
translations.text: 내 공을 쳐서 상대 공을 먼저 맞히세요. 점수는 그다음 그 공과 빨간 공이 한 일에서 나옵니다.

translations.key: Strike your own ball so it hits the other player's ball first. Points come from what that ball and the red do next.
translations.text: 击打自己的球，让它先碰对方的球。得分来自那个球和红球接下来的表现。

translations.key: Strike your own ball so it hits the other player's ball first. Points come from what that ball and the red do next.
translations.text: Бейте своим шаром так, чтобы он сначала попал в шар соперника. Очки дают то, что потом сделают этот шар и красный.

translations.key: Strike your own ball so it hits the other player's ball first. Points come from what that ball and the red do next.
translations.text: اضرب كرتك لتصيب كرة اللاعب الآخر أولًا. تأتي النقاط مما تفعله تلك الكرة والحمراء بعد ذلك.

translations.key: Each white pin down scores %lld. The red pin scores %lld, or %lld if it is the only pin to fall. The other player's ball hitting the red scores %lld.
translations.text: Cada bolo blanco derribado vale %1$lld. El bolo rojo vale %2$lld, o %3$lld si es el único que cae. Que la bola del rival toque la roja vale %4$lld.

translations.key: Each white pin down scores %lld. The red pin scores %lld, or %lld if it is the only pin to fall. The other player's ball hitting the red scores %lld.
translations.text: Chaque quille blanche tombée vaut %1$lld. La quille rouge vaut %2$lld, ou %3$lld si elle est seule à tomber. La bille adverse qui touche la rouge vaut %4$lld.

translations.key: Each white pin down scores %lld. The red pin scores %lld, or %lld if it is the only pin to fall. The other player's ball hitting the red scores %lld.
translations.text: Jeder gefallene weiße Kegel zählt %1$lld. Der rote Kegel zählt %2$lld, oder %3$lld, wenn er als einziger fällt. Trifft die Kugel des Gegners die Rote, zählt das %4$lld.

translations.key: Each white pin down scores %lld. The red pin scores %lld, or %lld if it is the only pin to fall. The other player's ball hitting the red scores %lld.
translations.text: Ogni birillo bianco abbattuto vale %1$lld. Il birillo rosso vale %2$lld, o %3$lld se è l’unico a cadere. La bilia avversaria che colpisce la rossa vale %4$lld.

translations.key: Each white pin down scores %lld. The red pin scores %lld, or %lld if it is the only pin to fall. The other player's ball hitting the red scores %lld.
translations.text: Cada pino branco derrubado vale %1$lld. O pino vermelho vale %2$lld, ou %3$lld se for o único a cair. A bola do adversário a bater na vermelha vale %4$lld.

translations.key: Each white pin down scores %lld. The red pin scores %lld, or %lld if it is the only pin to fall. The other player's ball hitting the red scores %lld.
translations.text: Cada pino branco derrubado vale %1$lld. O pino vermelho vale %2$lld, ou %3$lld se for o único a cair. A bola do adversário batendo na vermelha vale %4$lld.

translations.key: Each white pin down scores %lld. The red pin scores %lld, or %lld if it is the only pin to fall. The other player's ball hitting the red scores %lld.
translations.text: 白ピン1本で%1$lld点。赤ピンは%2$lld点、赤ピンだけが倒れたら%3$lld点。相手の球が赤球に当たると%4$lld点です。

translations.key: Each white pin down scores %lld. The red pin scores %lld, or %lld if it is the only pin to fall. The other player's ball hitting the red scores %lld.
translations.text: 흰 핀 하나당 %1$lld점. 빨간 핀은 %2$lld점이며, 빨간 핀만 쓰러지면 %3$lld점. 상대 공이 빨간 공을 맞히면 %4$lld점입니다.

translations.key: Each white pin down scores %lld. The red pin scores %lld, or %lld if it is the only pin to fall. The other player's ball hitting the red scores %lld.
translations.text: 每倒一根白柱得%1$lld分。红柱得%2$lld分，如果只倒红柱则得%3$lld分。对方的球碰到红球得%4$lld分。

translations.key: Each white pin down scores %lld. The red pin scores %lld, or %lld if it is the only pin to fall. The other player's ball hitting the red scores %lld.
translations.text: Каждая сбитая белая кегля — %1$lld. Красная кегля — %2$lld, или %3$lld, если упала только она. Шар соперника, задевший красный, — %4$lld.

translations.key: Each white pin down scores %lld. The red pin scores %lld, or %lld if it is the only pin to fall. The other player's ball hitting the red scores %lld.
translations.text: كل وتد أبيض يسقط يساوي %1$lld. الوتد الأحمر يساوي %2$lld، أو %3$lld إن سقط وحده. وإصابة كرة الخصم للحمراء تساوي %4$lld.

translations.key: Missing the other ball, hitting the red first, knocking a pin with your own ball, or sending a ball off the table is a foul. The shot's points go to the other player, and never fewer than %lld.
translations.text: Fallar la otra bola, tocar primero la roja, derribar un bolo con tu propia bola o sacar una bola de la mesa es falta. Los puntos del tiro son para el otro jugador, y nunca menos de %lld.

translations.key: Missing the other ball, hitting the red first, knocking a pin with your own ball, or sending a ball off the table is a foul. The shot's points go to the other player, and never fewer than %lld.
translations.text: Manquer l’autre bille, toucher d’abord la rouge, faire tomber une quille avec sa propre bille ou envoyer une bille hors de la table est une faute. Les points du coup vont à l’autre joueur, jamais moins de %lld.

translations.key: Missing the other ball, hitting the red first, knocking a pin with your own ball, or sending a ball off the table is a foul. The shot's points go to the other player, and never fewer than %lld.
translations.text: Die andere Kugel verfehlen, zuerst die Rote treffen, mit der eigenen Kugel einen Kegel umwerfen oder eine Kugel vom Tisch stoßen ist ein Foul. Die Punkte des Stoßes gehen an den anderen, nie weniger als %lld.

translations.key: Missing the other ball, hitting the red first, knocking a pin with your own ball, or sending a ball off the table is a foul. The shot's points go to the other player, and never fewer than %lld.
translations.text: Mancare l’altra bilia, prendere prima la rossa, abbattere un birillo con la propria bilia o mandare una bilia fuori dal tavolo è fallo. I punti del tiro vanno all’altro giocatore, mai meno di %lld.

translations.key: Missing the other ball, hitting the red first, knocking a pin with your own ball, or sending a ball off the table is a foul. The shot's points go to the other player, and never fewer than %lld.
translations.text: Falhar a outra bola, acertar primeiro na vermelha, derrubar um pino com a tua própria bola ou atirar uma bola para fora da mesa é falta. Os pontos da tacada vão para o outro jogador, e nunca menos de %lld.

translations.key: Missing the other ball, hitting the red first, knocking a pin with your own ball, or sending a ball off the table is a foul. The shot's points go to the other player, and never fewer than %lld.
translations.text: Errar a outra bola, acertar primeiro a vermelha, derrubar um pino com a sua própria bola ou jogar uma bola para fora da mesa é falta. Os pontos da tacada vão para o outro jogador, e nunca menos de %lld.

translations.key: Missing the other ball, hitting the red first, knocking a pin with your own ball, or sending a ball off the table is a foul. The shot's points go to the other player, and never fewer than %lld.
translations.text: 相手の球に当てられない、先に赤球に当てる、自分の球でピンを倒す、球を台の外に出す、はファウルです。そのショットの得点は相手に入り、最低%lld点です。

translations.key: Missing the other ball, hitting the red first, knocking a pin with your own ball, or sending a ball off the table is a foul. The shot's points go to the other player, and never fewer than %lld.
translations.text: 상대 공을 놓치거나, 빨간 공을 먼저 맞히거나, 내 공으로 핀을 쓰러뜨리거나, 공을 테이블 밖으로 보내면 파울입니다. 그 샷의 점수는 상대에게 가며, 최소 %lld점입니다.

translations.key: Missing the other ball, hitting the red first, knocking a pin with your own ball, or sending a ball off the table is a foul. The shot's points go to the other player, and never fewer than %lld.
translations.text: 没碰到对方的球、先碰红球、用自己的球撞倒木柱，或把球打出台面，都是犯规。这一杆的分数归对方，且至少%lld分。

translations.key: Missing the other ball, hitting the red first, knocking a pin with your own ball, or sending a ball off the table is a foul. The shot's points go to the other player, and never fewer than %lld.
translations.text: Промах по шару соперника, первый удар в красный, кегля, сбитая своим шаром, или шар, вылетевший со стола, — фол. Очки за удар получает соперник, не меньше %lld.

translations.key: Missing the other ball, hitting the red first, knocking a pin with your own ball, or sending a ball off the table is a foul. The shot's points go to the other player, and never fewer than %lld.
translations.text: إخطاء كرة الخصم، أو إصابة الحمراء أولًا، أو إسقاط وتد بكرتك، أو إخراج كرة من الطاولة، خطأ. تذهب نقاط الضربة إلى اللاعب الآخر، ولا تقل عن %lld.

translations.key: Turns alternate after every shot. The pins are stood up again, and a ball resting on a pin's spot goes back to its own spot.
translations.text: Los turnos se alternan tras cada tiro. Los bolos se vuelven a poner de pie, y una bola parada sobre el sitio de un bolo vuelve a su propio punto.

translations.key: Turns alternate after every shot. The pins are stood up again, and a ball resting on a pin's spot goes back to its own spot.
translations.text: On joue chacun son tour après chaque coup. Les quilles sont relevées, et une bille arrêtée sur l’emplacement d’une quille retourne sur son propre point.

translations.key: Turns alternate after every shot. The pins are stood up again, and a ball resting on a pin's spot goes back to its own spot.
translations.text: Nach jedem Stoß wechselt der Zug. Die Kegel werden wieder aufgestellt, und eine Kugel auf dem Platz eines Kegels kommt auf ihren eigenen Punkt zurück.

translations.key: Turns alternate after every shot. The pins are stood up again, and a ball resting on a pin's spot goes back to its own spot.
translations.text: I turni si alternano dopo ogni tiro. I birilli vengono rialzati, e una bilia ferma sul posto di un birillo torna sul suo punto.

translations.key: Turns alternate after every shot. The pins are stood up again, and a ball resting on a pin's spot goes back to its own spot.
translations.text: A vez alterna depois de cada tacada. Os pinos voltam a ser levantados, e uma bola parada no lugar de um pino volta ao seu próprio ponto.

translations.key: Turns alternate after every shot. The pins are stood up again, and a ball resting on a pin's spot goes back to its own spot.
translations.text: A vez alterna depois de cada tacada. Os pinos são levantados de novo, e uma bola parada no lugar de um pino volta para o seu próprio ponto.

translations.key: Turns alternate after every shot. The pins are stood up again, and a ball resting on a pin's spot goes back to its own spot.
translations.text: ショットごとに交代します。ピンは立て直され、ピンの位置に止まった球は自分のスポットに戻ります。

translations.key: Turns alternate after every shot. The pins are stood up again, and a ball resting on a pin's spot goes back to its own spot.
translations.text: 샷마다 차례가 바뀝니다. 핀은 다시 세워지고, 핀 자리에 멈춘 공은 제자리 점으로 돌아갑니다.

translations.key: Turns alternate after every shot. The pins are stood up again, and a ball resting on a pin's spot goes back to its own spot.
translations.text: 每杆之后轮换。木柱重新立起，停在木柱位置上的球放回自己的置球点。

translations.key: Turns alternate after every shot. The pins are stood up again, and a ball resting on a pin's spot goes back to its own spot.
translations.text: Ход переходит после каждого удара. Кегли снова ставят, а шар, стоящий на месте кегли, возвращается на свою отметку.

translations.key: Turns alternate after every shot. The pins are stood up again, and a ball resting on a pin's spot goes back to its own spot.
translations.text: يتناوب الدور بعد كل ضربة. تُعاد الأوتاد واقفة، وتعود الكرة المستقرة مكان وتد إلى نقطتها.

translations.key: The first to %lld points wins.
translations.text: Gana el primero que llegue a %lld puntos.

translations.key: The first to %lld points wins.
translations.text: Le premier à %lld points gagne.

translations.key: The first to %lld points wins.
translations.text: Wer zuerst %lld Punkte hat, gewinnt.

translations.key: The first to %lld points wins.
translations.text: Vince il primo che arriva a %lld punti.

translations.key: The first to %lld points wins.
translations.text: Ganha o primeiro a chegar a %lld pontos.

translations.key: The first to %lld points wins.
translations.text: Ganha o primeiro a chegar a %lld pontos.

translations.key: The first to %lld points wins.
translations.text: 先に%lld点に達した人の勝ちです。

translations.key: The first to %lld points wins.
translations.text: 먼저 %lld점에 도달한 사람이 이깁니다.

translations.key: The first to %lld points wins.
translations.text: 先到%lld分者获胜。

translations.key: The first to %lld points wins.
translations.text: Побеждает тот, кто первым наберёт %lld очков.

translations.key: The first to %lld points wins.
translations.text: يفوز أول من يبلغ %lld نقطة.

translations.key: One or two players against a %lld-minute clock. Two players take breaks in turn and the higher score wins; alone, you play for your best score.
translations.text: Uno o dos jugadores contra un reloj de %lld minutos. Dos jugadores hacen tacadas por turnos y gana la puntuación más alta; solo, juegas por tu récord.

translations.key: One or two players against a %lld-minute clock. Two players take breaks in turn and the higher score wins; alone, you play for your best score.
translations.text: Un ou deux joueurs contre un chrono de %lld minutes. À deux, on joue des séries à tour de rôle et le meilleur score gagne ; seul, vous visez votre record.

translations.key: One or two players against a %lld-minute clock. Two players take breaks in turn and the higher score wins; alone, you play for your best score.
translations.text: Ein oder zwei Spieler gegen eine Uhr von %lld Minuten. Zu zweit spielt man abwechselnd Serien und die höhere Punktzahl gewinnt; allein spielst du für deinen Rekord.

translations.key: One or two players against a %lld-minute clock. Two players take breaks in turn and the higher score wins; alone, you play for your best score.
translations.text: Uno o due giocatori contro un orologio di %lld minuti. In due si fanno serie a turno e vince il punteggio più alto; da solo giochi per il tuo record.

translations.key: One or two players against a %lld-minute clock. Two players take breaks in turn and the higher score wins; alone, you play for your best score.
translations.text: Um ou dois jogadores contra um relógio de %lld minutos. A dois, jogam séries à vez e ganha a pontuação mais alta; sozinho, jogas pelo teu recorde.

translations.key: One or two players against a %lld-minute clock. Two players take breaks in turn and the higher score wins; alone, you play for your best score.
translations.text: Um ou dois jogadores contra um relógio de %lld minutos. Em dupla, cada um joga sua série por vez e vence a maior pontuação; sozinho, você joga pelo seu recorde.

translations.key: One or two players against a %lld-minute clock. Two players take breaks in turn and the higher score wins; alone, you play for your best score.
translations.text: 1人か2人で、%lld分の時計と勝負します。2人なら交代でブレイクし、得点の高いほうが勝ち。1人なら最高得点を目指します。

translations.key: One or two players against a %lld-minute clock. Two players take breaks in turn and the higher score wins; alone, you play for your best score.
translations.text: 한 명 또는 두 명이 %lld분 시계와 겨룹니다. 두 명이면 번갈아 연속 득점을 하고 점수가 높은 쪽이 이기며, 혼자면 최고 점수를 노립니다.

translations.key: One or two players against a %lld-minute clock. Two players take breaks in turn and the higher score wins; alone, you play for your best score.
translations.text: 一到两名玩家，对抗%lld分钟的计时。双人时轮流连击，得分高者胜；单人时挑战自己的最高分。

translations.key: One or two players against a %lld-minute clock. Two players take breaks in turn and the higher score wins; alone, you play for your best score.
translations.text: Один или два игрока против часов на %lld минут. Вдвоём играют серии по очереди, побеждает больший счёт; в одиночку вы играете на рекорд.

translations.key: One or two players against a %lld-minute clock. Two players take breaks in turn and the higher score wins; alone, you play for your best score.
translations.text: لاعب أو لاعبان ضد ساعة مدتها %lld دقيقة. يتناوب اللاعبان على السلاسل ويفوز صاحب النتيجة الأعلى؛ ووحدك تلعب لأفضل نتيجة لك.

translations.key: Every shot is a white from the tray, placed on the spot in the D. The red starts on its own spot.
translations.text: Cada tiro se hace con una blanca de la bandeja, colocada en el punto de la D. La roja empieza en su propio punto.

translations.key: Every shot is a white from the tray, placed on the spot in the D. The red starts on its own spot.
translations.text: Chaque coup se joue avec une blanche prise dans le bac, posée sur le point du D. La rouge part de son propre point.

translations.key: Every shot is a white from the tray, placed on the spot in the D. The red starts on its own spot.
translations.text: Jeder Stoß wird mit einer Weißen aus der Rinne gespielt, auf den Punkt im D gelegt. Die Rote beginnt auf ihrem eigenen Punkt.

translations.key: Every shot is a white from the tray, placed on the spot in the D. The red starts on its own spot.
translations.text: Ogni tiro si gioca con una bianca presa dal vassoio, messa sul punto della D. La rossa parte dal suo punto.

translations.key: Every shot is a white from the tray, placed on the spot in the D. The red starts on its own spot.
translations.text: Cada tacada é com uma branca do tabuleiro, posta no ponto do D. A vermelha começa no seu próprio ponto.

translations.key: Every shot is a white from the tray, placed on the spot in the D. The red starts on its own spot.
translations.text: Cada tacada é com uma branca da bandeja, colocada no ponto do D. A vermelha começa no seu próprio ponto.

translations.key: Every shot is a white from the tray, placed on the spot in the D. The red starts on its own spot.
translations.text: 毎ショット、トレイの白球をDのスポットに置いて突きます。赤球は自分のスポットから始まります。

translations.key: Every shot is a white from the tray, placed on the spot in the D. The red starts on its own spot.
translations.text: 매 샷은 트레이에서 꺼낸 흰 공을 D 안의 점에 놓고 칩니다. 빨간 공은 자기 점에서 시작합니다.

translations.key: Every shot is a white from the tray, placed on the spot in the D. The red starts on its own spot.
translations.text: 每一杆都从球槽取一个白球，放在D区的置球点上。红球从自己的置球点开始。

translations.key: Every shot is a white from the tray, placed on the spot in the D. The red starts on its own spot.
translations.text: Каждый удар — белым шаром из лотка, поставленным на отметку в «D». Красный стоит на своей отметке.

translations.key: Every shot is a white from the tray, placed on the spot in the D. The red starts on its own spot.
translations.text: كل ضربة بكرة بيضاء من الصينية توضع على النقطة داخل منطقة D. وتبدأ الحمراء من نقطتها.

translations.key: Your ball must hit another ball first. Each ball that then drops scores the number by its hole, and the red scores double.
translations.text: Tu bola debe tocar antes otra bola. Cada bola que caiga después suma el número de su agujero, y la roja puntúa doble.

translations.key: Your ball must hit another ball first. Each ball that then drops scores the number by its hole, and the red scores double.
translations.text: Votre bille doit d’abord toucher une autre bille. Chaque bille qui tombe ensuite marque le nombre de son trou, et la rouge compte double.

translations.key: Your ball must hit another ball first. Each ball that then drops scores the number by its hole, and the red scores double.
translations.text: Deine Kugel muss zuerst eine andere Kugel treffen. Jede Kugel, die danach fällt, zählt die Zahl an ihrem Loch, die Rote doppelt.

translations.key: Your ball must hit another ball first. Each ball that then drops scores the number by its hole, and the red scores double.
translations.text: La tua bilia deve prima colpire un’altra bilia. Ogni bilia che poi cade vale il numero della sua buca, e la rossa vale doppio.

translations.key: Your ball must hit another ball first. Each ball that then drops scores the number by its hole, and the red scores double.
translations.text: A tua bola tem de acertar primeiro noutra bola. Cada bola que depois cair vale o número do seu buraco, e a vermelha conta a dobrar.

translations.key: Your ball must hit another ball first. Each ball that then drops scores the number by its hole, and the red scores double.
translations.text: Sua bola precisa acertar outra bola primeiro. Cada bola que cair depois vale o número do buraco, e a vermelha vale o dobro.

translations.key: Your ball must hit another ball first. Each ball that then drops scores the number by its hole, and the red scores double.
translations.text: 自分の球はまず別の球に当てます。そのあと落ちた球は穴の数字が得点になり、赤球は2倍です。

translations.key: Your ball must hit another ball first. Each ball that then drops scores the number by its hole, and the red scores double.
translations.text: 내 공이 먼저 다른 공을 맞혀야 합니다. 그 뒤 떨어진 공은 구멍에 적힌 숫자만큼 점수가 되고, 빨간 공은 두 배입니다.

translations.key: Your ball must hit another ball first. Each ball that then drops scores the number by its hole, and the red scores double.
translations.text: 你的球必须先碰到另一个球。之后落入的每个球得到其洞旁的分数，红球得双倍。

translations.key: Your ball must hit another ball first. Each ball that then drops scores the number by its hole, and the red scores double.
translations.text: Ваш шар должен сначала попасть в другой шар. Каждый упавший потом шар приносит число у своей лунки, красный — вдвойне.

translations.key: Your ball must hit another ball first. Each ball that then drops scores the number by its hole, and the red scores double.
translations.text: يجب أن تصيب كرتك كرة أخرى أولًا. كل كرة تسقط بعدها تسجل الرقم الذي بجانب حفرتها، والحمراء تُحسب مضاعفة.

translations.key: Your break goes on while every shot drops a ball. A shot that drops nothing ends it; a shot that hits no ball scores nothing and ends it.
translations.text: Tu tacada sigue mientras cada tiro meta una bola. Un tiro que no mete nada la termina; un tiro que no toca ninguna bola no puntúa y la termina.

translations.key: Your break goes on while every shot drops a ball. A shot that drops nothing ends it; a shot that hits no ball scores nothing and ends it.
translations.text: Votre série continue tant que chaque coup fait tomber une bille. Un coup qui ne fait rien tomber la termine ; un coup qui ne touche aucune bille ne marque rien et la termine.

translations.key: Your break goes on while every shot drops a ball. A shot that drops nothing ends it; a shot that hits no ball scores nothing and ends it.
translations.text: Deine Serie geht weiter, solange jeder Stoß eine Kugel versenkt. Ein Stoß, der nichts versenkt, beendet sie; ein Stoß, der keine Kugel trifft, zählt nichts und beendet sie.

translations.key: Your break goes on while every shot drops a ball. A shot that drops nothing ends it; a shot that hits no ball scores nothing and ends it.
translations.text: La tua serie continua finché ogni tiro fa cadere una bilia. Un tiro che non fa cadere nulla la chiude; un tiro che non tocca nessuna bilia non vale nulla e la chiude.

translations.key: Your break goes on while every shot drops a ball. A shot that drops nothing ends it; a shot that hits no ball scores nothing and ends it.
translations.text: A tua série continua enquanto cada tacada fizer cair uma bola. Uma tacada que não faz cair nada termina-a; uma tacada que não toca em nenhuma bola não vale nada e termina-a.

translations.key: Your break goes on while every shot drops a ball. A shot that drops nothing ends it; a shot that hits no ball scores nothing and ends it.
translations.text: Sua série continua enquanto cada tacada derrubar uma bola. Uma tacada que não derruba nada a encerra; uma tacada que não toca em nenhuma bola não vale nada e a encerra.

translations.key: Your break goes on while every shot drops a ball. A shot that drops nothing ends it; a shot that hits no ball scores nothing and ends it.
translations.text: 毎ショットで球が落ちる限りブレイクは続きます。何も落ちなければ終わり、どの球にも当たらなければ得点なしで終わりです。

translations.key: Your break goes on while every shot drops a ball. A shot that drops nothing ends it; a shot that hits no ball scores nothing and ends it.
translations.text: 샷마다 공이 떨어지는 동안 연속 득점이 이어집니다. 아무것도 떨어지지 않으면 끝나고, 아무 공도 맞히지 못하면 점수 없이 끝납니다.

translations.key: Your break goes on while every shot drops a ball. A shot that drops nothing ends it; a shot that hits no ball scores nothing and ends it.
translations.text: 只要每杆都有球落洞，连击就继续。没有球落洞则结束；没碰到任何球则不得分并结束。

translations.key: Your break goes on while every shot drops a ball. A shot that drops nothing ends it; a shot that hits no ball scores nothing and ends it.
translations.text: Серия продолжается, пока каждый удар роняет шар. Удар без падения шара её заканчивает; удар мимо всех шаров не приносит очков и тоже заканчивает её.

translations.key: Your break goes on while every shot drops a ball. A shot that drops nothing ends it; a shot that hits no ball scores nothing and ends it.
translations.text: تستمر سلسلتك ما دامت كل ضربة تُسقط كرة. الضربة التي لا تُسقط شيئًا تنهيها؛ والضربة التي لا تصيب أي كرة لا تسجل شيئًا وتنهيها.

translations.key: Knock down a white peg and the break ends with its points lost. Knock down the black peg and your whole score is lost.
translations.text: Si derribas una seta blanca, la tacada termina y pierdes sus puntos. Si derribas la seta negra, pierdes toda tu puntuación.

translations.key: Knock down a white peg and the break ends with its points lost. Knock down the black peg and your whole score is lost.
translations.text: Faites tomber un champignon blanc et la série s’arrête, ses points perdus. Faites tomber le champignon noir et tout votre score est perdu.

translations.key: Knock down a white peg and the break ends with its points lost. Knock down the black peg and your whole score is lost.
translations.text: Wirfst du einen weißen Pilz um, endet die Serie und ihre Punkte sind verloren. Wirfst du den schwarzen Pilz um, ist dein ganzer Punktestand verloren.

translations.key: Knock down a white peg and the break ends with its points lost. Knock down the black peg and your whole score is lost.
translations.text: Abbatti un funghetto bianco e la serie finisce, con i suoi punti persi. Abbatti il funghetto nero e perdi tutto il punteggio.

translations.key: Knock down a white peg and the break ends with its points lost. Knock down the black peg and your whole score is lost.
translations.text: Derruba um pino branco e a série acaba, perdendo os seus pontos. Derruba o pino preto e perdes toda a pontuação.

translations.key: Knock down a white peg and the break ends with its points lost. Knock down the black peg and your whole score is lost.
translations.text: Derrube um pino branco e a série acaba, perdendo seus pontos. Derrube o pino preto e você perde toda a pontuação.

translations.key: Knock down a white peg and the break ends with its points lost. Knock down the black peg and your whole score is lost.
translations.text: 白いペグを倒すとブレイクは終わり、その得点は失われます。黒いペグを倒すと、それまでの得点がすべて失われます。

translations.key: Knock down a white peg and the break ends with its points lost. Knock down the black peg and your whole score is lost.
translations.text: 흰 말뚝을 쓰러뜨리면 연속 득점이 끝나고 그 점수를 잃습니다. 검은 말뚝을 쓰러뜨리면 전체 점수를 잃습니다.

translations.key: Knock down a white peg and the break ends with its points lost. Knock down the black peg and your whole score is lost.
translations.text: 撞倒白色木桩，本轮结束且该轮分数作废。撞倒黑色木桩，全部分数作废。

translations.key: Knock down a white peg and the break ends with its points lost. Knock down the black peg and your whole score is lost.
translations.text: Сбили белый грибок — серия заканчивается, её очки сгорают. Сбили чёрный — сгорает весь счёт.

translations.key: Knock down a white peg and the break ends with its points lost. Knock down the black peg and your whole score is lost.
translations.text: أسقط وتدًا أبيض فتنتهي السلسلة وتضيع نقاطها. أسقط الوتد الأسود فتضيع نتيجتك كلها.

translations.key: Dropped balls come back to the tray and the red goes back on its spot, until time is up.
translations.text: Las bolas que caen vuelven a la bandeja y la roja vuelve a su punto, hasta que se acaba el tiempo.

translations.key: Dropped balls come back to the tray and the red goes back on its spot, until time is up.
translations.text: Les billes tombées reviennent dans le bac et la rouge retourne sur son point, jusqu’à la fin du temps.

translations.key: Dropped balls come back to the tray and the red goes back on its spot, until time is up.
translations.text: Gefallene Kugeln kommen zurück in die Rinne, die Rote auf ihren Punkt, bis die Zeit um ist.

translations.key: Dropped balls come back to the tray and the red goes back on its spot, until time is up.
translations.text: Le bilie cadute tornano nel vassoio e la rossa torna sul suo punto, finché il tempo non scade.

translations.key: Dropped balls come back to the tray and the red goes back on its spot, until time is up.
translations.text: As bolas que caem voltam ao tabuleiro e a vermelha volta ao seu ponto, até acabar o tempo.

translations.key: Dropped balls come back to the tray and the red goes back on its spot, until time is up.
translations.text: As bolas que caem voltam para a bandeja e a vermelha volta para o seu ponto, até o tempo acabar.

translations.key: Dropped balls come back to the tray and the red goes back on its spot, until time is up.
translations.text: 時間切れまでは、落ちた球はトレイに戻り、赤球はスポットに戻ります。

translations.key: Dropped balls come back to the tray and the red goes back on its spot, until time is up.
translations.text: 시간이 다 될 때까지, 떨어진 공은 트레이로 돌아오고 빨간 공은 제자리 점으로 돌아갑니다.

translations.key: Dropped balls come back to the tray and the red goes back on its spot, until time is up.
translations.text: 时间结束前，落洞的球回到球槽，红球放回置球点。

translations.key: Dropped balls come back to the tray and the red goes back on its spot, until time is up.
translations.text: Пока время не вышло, упавшие шары возвращаются в лоток, а красный — на свою отметку.

translations.key: Dropped balls come back to the tray and the red goes back on its spot, until time is up.
translations.text: تعود الكرات الساقطة إلى الصينية وتعود الحمراء إلى نقطتها، حتى ينتهي الوقت.

translations.key: When the clock runs out a bar drops: balls that drop stay down. Play goes on until no white is left, then the game ends. The clock stops while you watch a replay or the Lens.
translations.text: Cuando se acaba el tiempo baja una barra: las bolas que caen ya no vuelven. Se sigue jugando hasta que no quede ninguna blanca, y entonces termina la partida. El reloj se para mientras ves una repetición o la Lente.

translations.key: When the clock runs out a bar drops: balls that drop stay down. Play goes on until no white is left, then the game ends. The clock stops while you watch a replay or the Lens.
translations.text: Quand le chrono s’arrête, une barre descend : les billes qui tombent restent dedans. On joue jusqu’à ce qu’il ne reste aucune blanche, puis la partie se termine. Le chrono s’arrête pendant un ralenti ou la Lentille.

translations.key: When the clock runs out a bar drops: balls that drop stay down. Play goes on until no white is left, then the game ends. The clock stops while you watch a replay or the Lens.
translations.text: Wenn die Uhr abgelaufen ist, fällt eine Sperre: Kugeln, die fallen, bleiben unten. Gespielt wird, bis keine Weiße mehr übrig ist, dann endet das Spiel. Die Uhr steht, solange du eine Wiederholung oder die Lens ansiehst.

translations.key: When the clock runs out a bar drops: balls that drop stay down. Play goes on until no white is left, then the game ends. The clock stops while you watch a replay or the Lens.
translations.text: Quando il tempo scade scende una barra: le bilie che cadono restano giù. Si gioca finché non resta nessuna bianca, poi la partita finisce. L’orologio si ferma mentre guardi un replay o la Lens.

translations.key: When the clock runs out a bar drops: balls that drop stay down. Play goes on until no white is left, then the game ends. The clock stops while you watch a replay or the Lens.
translations.text: Quando o tempo acaba desce uma barra: as bolas que caem ficam lá dentro. Joga-se até não restar nenhuma branca, e aí o jogo termina. O relógio para enquanto vês uma repetição ou a Lente.

translations.key: When the clock runs out a bar drops: balls that drop stay down. Play goes on until no white is left, then the game ends. The clock stops while you watch a replay or the Lens.
translations.text: Quando o tempo acaba, desce uma barra: as bolas que caem ficam lá dentro. O jogo continua até não sobrar nenhuma branca e então termina. O relógio para enquanto você vê um replay ou a Lente.

translations.key: When the clock runs out a bar drops: balls that drop stay down. Play goes on until no white is left, then the game ends. The clock stops while you watch a replay or the Lens.
translations.text: 時間切れになるとバーが下り、落ちた球は戻らなくなります。白球がなくなるまで続け、なくなったらゲーム終了です。リプレイやレンズを見ている間は時計が止まります。

translations.key: When the clock runs out a bar drops: balls that drop stay down. Play goes on until no white is left, then the game ends. The clock stops while you watch a replay or the Lens.
translations.text: 시간이 다 되면 바가 내려가 떨어진 공은 돌아오지 않습니다. 흰 공이 남지 않을 때까지 계속하고, 그러면 게임이 끝납니다. 다시보기나 렌즈를 보는 동안에는 시계가 멈춥니다.

translations.key: When the clock runs out a bar drops: balls that drop stay down. Play goes on until no white is left, then the game ends. The clock stops while you watch a replay or the Lens.
translations.text: 时间用完后挡杆落下：落洞的球不再返回。继续打到没有白球为止，然后比赛结束。观看回放或透镜时计时暂停。

translations.key: When the clock runs out a bar drops: balls that drop stay down. Play goes on until no white is left, then the game ends. The clock stops while you watch a replay or the Lens.
translations.text: Когда время выходит, опускается планка: упавшие шары больше не возвращаются. Игра идёт, пока не кончатся белые, затем заканчивается. Часы стоят, пока вы смотрите повтор или Линзу.

translations.text: عندما ينتهي الوقت ينزل حاجز: الكرات التي تسقط تبقى في الأسفل. يستمر اللعب حتى لا تبقى كرة بيضاء، ثم تنتهي اللعبة. تتوقف الساعة أثناء مشاهدة الإعادة أو العدسة.
